title: Assisted code review and test generation

videos.script: A review from an assistant is a list of claims. Some are bugs, some are questions, and some are wrong. {{claims}} In this lesson you check each claim the only way that settles it, with a test that fails if the claim is true. {{triage}} Then you ask for tests, and get a file that passes on code with a known bug. {{pinned}} That is not a flaw of the assistant. It wrote down what the code does, because the code was all it had. Tests have to come from what the code is for. {{spec}} From there, three ways to find what nobody wrote a test for. A table of edge cases. {{edges}} Properties that must hold for every input, where two bugs cancel each other out until one is fixed. {{properties}} And mutants, small changes to the code that the tests should notice and sometimes do not. {{mutants}}
